A Scan operation in Amazon DynamoDB reads every item in a table or a secondary index. By 
default, a Scan operation returns all of the data attributes for every item in the table or index. You 
can use the ProjectionExpression parameter so that Scan only returns some of the attributes, 
rather than all of them.

ﬁlter expression to this data, narrowing the results before they are returned to the user.
